changelog:
mano-afk 1.0.8

- Simplified and clarified the E2E setup process in Step 0; users are now prompted to opt in to E2E testing, with clear guidance and an option to skip.
- Adjusted the E2E test section (Step 4.3) to explicitly check for prerequisites, and clarified that installation actions are not taken autonomously during testing.
- Made minor streamlining and clarity improvements throughout user-facing instructions, especially around E2E workflow and configuration.
- No code or file changes in this release; documentation update only.
